title: Patch: a card that dies goes to the graveyard of the player who controlled it
notes: A card that leaves the field for a graveyard goes to its controller's, and a card that leaves the resolving zone for one to the graveyard of the player who played it, as that player's own card (R2618000, amending R12, R172, R360, R453, R747, R803, R1282, R1852002 and R1859012). A stolen Unit that dies is the thief's in the thief's graveyard, and a stolen Starship Piece builds the thief's ship. An Exile or a shuffle from the field still goes to the owner.

player.title: A card goes to the graveyard of the side it died on
changes: A Unit you took from your opponent that dies now goes to your graveyard as your card, not back to theirs. A backrow card you took does the same when it is used up or destroyed.
A Starship Piece you took that dies now fuses into your Starship, not its old owner's.
Shadowstep returns a Unit you took that dies to your hand, since it is in your graveyard.
